brief: JPM's International Market Intelligence morning note frames a tactically cautious 'Global Narrowing' equity view: strong September flash PMIs and a global capex survey point to broad cyclical strength, but rising yields toward a 5.5% fair value keep JPM cautious near-term, planning to buy the dip via a broadening trade since similar yield episodes have historically been buying opportunities and sovereign-debt limits (180-230% of GDP OECD median) remain far above the 55.5% end-2025 level. Within Tech, JPM stays bullish but expects dispersion: Meta's Muse app frames a long-Software, short-consumer-inertia pairs trade, while a separate note on China's AI value chain argues token demand will rise ~60x by 2030E and profit pools will shift from infrastructure to downstream monetization, worth $544bn cumulative 2026E-30E, favoring Alibaba, Tencent and Z.AI. Regionally JPM stays long US/Asia versus EU, is adding EU index hedges despite a bullish EU stance since May, and runs EM tactical longs in China H-shares, KWEB and Taiwan. Separately: Japan megabanks over regionals, and hedge-fund positioning shows quant-led re-grossing with US crowding near a possible trough.
